description: Every committed R-CD-2 run whose run-local seat-readiness.json is a v2 receipt (connected as cli, no recorded auth method), each with the sha256 of that file's exact bytes, as on docs main at 9ba5518b. The runs are <candidate>/<row>/<seat>/<run> under the authority root (PROOFS/ in this repository, the matrix output root for a raw run). Three of them back the R-CD-2 KEYED-AUTHORITY-REVIEW.json of corpora 08c37a15, 293c977f (843e883b) and f15237ec; 293c977f's matrix-012658Z run (5e4ce138) is a PARTIAL kept as provenance, committed under a seat folder that is not its signed seat, so it cannot re-verify from PROOFS whatever its receipt. lib/r-cd-2-authority-context.mjs re-verifies the v2 receipt of a listed run with the bytes pinned here, exactly as v2 did: v2 shape, signature, run bindings. No other v2 receipt is accepted anywhere, and no gate in front of a live run reads this list. This list is frozen: a run made after the v3 receipt never joins it, and changing an entry is a deliberate, reviewed act.
